name: chatapp
description: Real-time chat application with microservices architecture

scripts.dev:backend: concurrently "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:chat" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:auth && npm run build:chat && npm run build:api
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../services/auth-service && npm install && cd ../chat-service && npm install && cd ../api-gateway && npm install

author: ChatApp Team
